summary: Code review of 4 bug fixes for MegaRadio React Native app - Lock screen metadata revert, rewarded ad cancel stuck, interstitial frequency, and first-launch interstitial. ALL BUG FIXES VERIFIED CORRECT.

findings: Lines 9-16: playerStoreRef import wrapped in try/catch for Android headless mode graceful handling
Lines 103-104: AsyncStorage.setItem saves station for persistence
Lines 106-118: CRITICAL FIX - After AsyncStorage save, directly syncs Zustand store via playerStoreRef.getState().setCurrentStation(station) and setPlaybackState('playing')
This ensures AudioProvider reads CORRECT station from Zustand when ICY metadata arrives, preventing metadata revert to old station name
BUG_FIX_1_Lock_Screen_Metadata.root_cause_addressed: service.js was updating TrackPlayer and AsyncStorage but NOT Zustand store. AudioProvider's ICY metadata handler reads currentStation from Zustand, so it was using stale data.

findings: Line 381: 'resolved' flag declared to prevent double-resolution
Lines 384-397: RewardedAdEventType.EARNED_REWARD listener sets resolved=true and resolves with {success: true, reward}
Lines 399-411: CRITICAL FIX - AdEventType.CLOSED listener added that checks !resolved and resolves with {success: false}
Lines 414-422: Error handler also checks !resolved before resolving
All code paths properly clean up listeners via rewardListener() and closeListener()
BUG_FIX_2_Rewarded_Ad_Cancel_Stuck.root_cause_addressed: Old code only had EARNED_REWARD listener. If user closed ad without earning reward, promise NEVER resolved, causing button to stay in loading state forever.

findings: Line 316-322: onStationChange() shows ad on first play (count===1) AND every 3 station changes
Line 115: splashHidden state declared with useState(false)
Lines 404-409: useEffect sets splashHidden=true when fontsLoaded && countryLoaded
Lines 221-260: AdMob useEffect depends on splashHidden, only runs when true
Lines 233-242: After successful initialization, setTimeout calls showInterstitialAd() after 5000ms (5 seconds)
Timing chain: splash hides → 1.5s delay → AdMob.initialize() → 5s delay → showInterstitialAd()
Lines 9-16: playerStoreRef import wrapped in try/catch
Lines 116-118: Zustand store sync also wrapped in try/catch with descriptive error message
This handles Android headless mode where Zustand store may not be available

notes: Proper error handling with try/catch for both import and usage
Clear comments explaining the fix rationale
Graceful degradation - if store unavailable, continues without crashing
Proper use of 'resolved' flag pattern to prevent race conditions
Both EARNED_REWARD and CLOSED listeners properly clean up
Error handler also respects the resolved flag
Retry logic for failed AdMob initialization

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 bug fixes are correctly implemented with proper error handling
Lock screen metadata fix correctly syncs Zustand store to prevent ICY metadata from reverting to old station
Rewarded ad cancel fix uses 'resolved' flag pattern correctly to prevent stuck loading state
First-launch interstitial timing (5s after init) gives ads time to load
Android headless mode gracefully handled with try/catch

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All bug fixes verified via code review

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified via code review. Lock screen metadata, rewarded ad cancel, interstitial frequency (3), and first-launch interstitial (5s delay) are all correctly implemented. Native iOS/Android features cannot be tested in this environment but code logic is correct.

rca_of_the_issue.Lock_Screen_Metadata_Revert: Root cause: service.js updated TrackPlayer and AsyncStorage when switching stations via lock screen, but AudioProvider's ICY metadata handler reads currentStation from Zustand store which was NOT updated. Fix: service.js now directly updates Zustand store after AsyncStorage.setItem.
rca_of_the_issue.Rewarded_Ad_Cancel_Stuck: Root cause: showRewardedAd() Promise only had EARNED_REWARD listener. If user closed ad without watching fully, no listener fired and Promise never resolved, leaving button in loading state. Fix: Added CLOSED listener that resolves with {success: false}.
